arxiv-2207-11245.title: Generating coherent phonon waves in narrow-band materials: a twisted bilayer graphene phaser
arxiv-2207-11245.creator: Iliya Esin, Ilya Esterlis, Eugene Demler, Gil Refael
arxiv-2207-11245.description: Abstract Twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) exhibits extremely low Fermi velocities for electrons, with the speed of sound surpassing the Fermi velocity. This regime enables the use of TBG for amplifying vibrational waves of the lattice through stimulated emission, following the same principles of operation of free-electron lasers.

arxiv-2209-05628.title: BFS 10: A nascent bipolar H II region in a filamentary molecular cloud 2022 BFS 10: A nascent bipolar H II region in a filamentary molecular cloud – References
arxiv-2209-05628.creator: Nicholas Larose, C. R. Kerton
arxiv-2209-05628.description: Abstract We present a study of the compact blister H ii region BFS 10 and its highly filamentary molecular cloud. We utilize 12 CO observations from the Five College Radio Astronomy Observatory to determine the distance, size, mass, and velocity structure of the molecular cloud.

arxiv-2210-11591.title: microAI: A machine learning tool for fast calculation of lift coefficients in microchannels
arxiv-2210-11591.creator: Erfan HamdiDepartment of Mechanical EngineeringSharif University of TechnologyTehran, Azadi St. erfan.hamdi@mech.sharif.ir, Rasool DezhkamDepartment of Mechanical EngineeringSharif University of TechnologyTehran, Azadi St. rasool.dezhkam@sharif.edu Amir ShamlooDepartment of Mechanical EngineeringSha
arxiv-2210-11591.description: Abstract There have been multiple methods proposed to calculate lift coefficients in microfluidic channels. One of the most used methods is using Direct Numerical Simulation. DNS is a very accurate yet computationally expensive method. DNS computations comprise most of the time consumed on a microfluidic simulation done by commercial software.

arxiv-2306-04874.title: Expanding Scope: Adapting English Adversarial Attacks to Chinese
arxiv-2306-04874.creator: Hanyu Liu, Chengyuan Cai, Yanjun Qi
arxiv-2306-04874.description: Abstract Recent studies have revealed that NLP predictive models are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Most existing studies focused on designing attacks to evaluate the robustness of NLP models in the English language alone. Literature has seen an increasing need for NLP solutions for other languages. We, therefore, ask one natural question: whether state-of-the-art (SOTA) attack methods generalize to other languages.

arxiv-2310-08660.title: Learning RL-Policies for Joint Beamforming Without Exploration: A Batch Constrained Off-Policy Approach
arxiv-2310-08660.creator: Heasung Kim*, Sravan Kumar Ankireddy*
arxiv-2310-08660.description: Abstract In this work, we consider the problem of network parameter optimization for rate maximization. We frame this as a joint optimization problem of power control, beam forming, and interference cancellation. We consider the setting where multiple Base Stations (BSs) communicate with multiple user equipment (UEs).

arxiv-2410-13869.title: A Federated Learning Platform as a Service for Advancing Stroke Management in European Clinical Centers Thanks: This project is funded by the Horizon EU project TRUSTroke in the call HORIZON-HLTH-2022-STAYHLTH-01-two-stage under GA No. 101080564.

arxiv-2410-13869.description: Abstract The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies holds transformative potential for the healthcare sector. In critical situations requiring immediate decision-making, healthcare professionals can leverage machine learning (ML) algorithms to prioritize and optimize treatment options, thereby reducing costs and improving patient outcomes.

arxiv-2410-22212.title: Charging a quantum spin network towards Heisenberg-limited precision
arxiv-2410-22212.creator: Beatrice Donelli, Stefano Gherardini, Raffaele Marino, Francesco Campaioli, Lorenzo Buffoni
arxiv-2410-22212.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Beatrice Donelli, Stefano Gherardini, Raffaele Marino, Francesco Campaioli, Lorenzo Buffoni. We present a cooperative protocol to charge quantum spin networks up to the highest-energy configuration, in terms of the network’s magnetization. The charging protocol leverages spin-spin interactions and the crossing of a phase transition’s critical point.

arxiv-2411-02202.description: Abstract This work uses twin 22-year free-running simulations of the Gulf of Mexico hydrodynamics performed with the HYCOM, one considering only ocean dynamics and the other incorporating atmospheric forcing, to study the behavior of the Yucatan Channel transport (YCT), the Loop Current (LC), the Loop Current Eddies (LCEs), their relationships, and the atmospheric forcing effect on them in short (daily)

arxiv-2511-12109.title: Exploring Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Backtranslation for the WMT 25 General Translation Task
arxiv-2511-12109.creator: Felipe Ribeiro Fujita de Mello, Hideyuki Takada
arxiv-2511-12109.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore the effectiveness of combining fine-tuning and backtranslation on a small Japanese corpus for neural machine translation. Starting from a baseline English→Japanese model (COMET = 0.460), we first apply backtranslation (BT) using synthetic data generated from monolingual Japanese corpora, yielding a modest increase (COMET = 0.468).

arxiv-2512-23007.title: Derivation of nonlinear time-dependent macroscopic conductivity for an electropermeabilization model via homogenization
arxiv-2512-23007.creator: Tobias Gebäck, Ioanna Motschan-Armen, Irina Pettersson
arxiv-2512-23007.description: Abstract We study a phenomenological electropermeabilization model in a periodic medium representing biological tissue. Starting from a cell-level model describing the electric potential and the degree of porosity, we perform dimension analysis to identify a relevant scaling in terms of a small parameter ε \varepsilon - the ratio between the cell and the tissue size.

pmc-11555462.title: Fungal Malignant Otitis Externa: A Systematic Review
pmc-11555462.creator: Giorgos Sideris, Dioni-Pinelopi Petsiou, Melina Kourklidou, Nikolaos Papadimitriou, Petros V Vlastarakos, Sotirios Karamagkiolas, Ioannis Margaris, Thomas Nikolopoulos, Alexander Delides
pmc-11555462.description: Malignant otitis externa (MOE) is a rare but serious condition primarily caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Fungi, particularly in immunocompromised individuals, can also be a contributing factor. A systematic review was conducted, following PRISMA guidelines, to evaluate the literature on fungal malignant otitis externa (FMOE), focusing on its etiology, patient demographics, clinical presentation, and treatment.

pmc-11606131.title: Risk factors for peptic ulcer bleeding one year after the initial episode
pmc-11606131.creator: Yu-Xuan Peng, Wen-Pei Chang
pmc-11606131.description: BackgroundPeptic ulcers are a common gastrointestinal disease that could cause death when combined with bleeding. The aim of this study was to identify risk factors for peptic ulcer bleeding (PUB) recurrence after the initial episode.MethodsThis retrospective study analyzed medical records of PUB patients who were admitted through the emergency department between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2022.

pmc-11607147.title: Species Identification and Genotyping of Cutaneous Leishmaniasis in Clinical Samples Based on ITS1-PCR-Sequencing in Southeast Iran
pmc-11607147.creator: Mansour Dabirzadeh, Saeid Rahim, Mohammadreza Beheshtizadeh, Hakim Azizi, Bahman Fooladi
pmc-11607147.description: Background:Cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL) is one of the most common parasitic diseases in many regions of Iran. It has a major role in deprived societies. We aimed to identify Leishmania species based on molecular as ITS1-rDNA-PCR internal transcribed spacer 1 (ITS1) region, microscopy, and culture techniques in diagnosing cutaneous leishmaniasis.

pmc-11621183.title: Calcium and vitamin D substitution for hypoparathyroidism after thyroidectomy – how is it continued after discharge from hospital?
pmc-11621183.creator: Julia I. Staubitz-Vernazza, Ann-Kathrin Lederer, Nabila Bouzakri, Oana Lozan, Florian Wild, Thomas J. Musholt
pmc-11621183.description: PurposePostoperative hypoparathyroidism (HypoPT) is one of the most feared complications after thyroid surgery. In most cases, HypoPT is transient, requiring temporary substitution with calcium and active vitamin D. The analysis was conducted to investigate how calcium and vitamin D substitution was managed in routine postoperative clinical practice after discharge from hospital.

pmc-12382988.title: Prevalence and Molecular Characterization of Bartonella spp. in Ectoparasites of Cats and Dogs in Northwestern Italy
pmc-12382988.creator: Angela Maria Catania, Laura Tomassone, Alberto Tarducci, Elena Grego
pmc-12382988.description: Simple SummaryBartonella henselae is a bacterium that can be transmitted from animals to humans, mainly through insect vectors like fleas. It is commonly found in cats, which often do not show signs of illness, but the infection can pose a risk to humans. Dogs can also carry other Bartonella species. In this study, we investigated the presence of Bartonella spp.

pmc-12714774.title: Generation and characterization of early stage oral cancer cell line of buccal mucosa of Indian origin
pmc-12714774.creator: Akhila George, Sudhir Nair, Kumar Prabhash, Sayujata Thakur, Poonam Gera, Arjun Singh, Pankaj Chaturvedi, Swapnil Rane, Trupti Pradhan, Subrata Sen, Madan Barkume, Dhanlaxmi Shetty, Kruti Chaubal, Arpita Ghosh, Sanjeev Kamte, Jyoti Anand Kode
pmc-12714774.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Being topmost cancer in India, oral cancer management warrants discovery of novel biomarkers, treatment strategies, and targets to help with early diagnosis, treatment, and recovery. To have a continuous supply of cells, the study was aimed at generation and characterization of established cell line from buccal mucosa (BM) tumors from patients of Indian origin which can be developed as a pre-clinical tool for biomedical application. Surgically resected tumor tissue from histo-pathologically confirmed oral cancer were processed for explant culture.

pmc-13214570.title: Multispectral 7 Tesla MRI as a potential predictor of dopamine transporter deficiency in Parkinson’s disease
pmc-13214570.creator: Mert Özer, Bernhard Egger, Angelika Mennecke, Armin Nagel, Moritz Zaiss, Frederik Bernd Laun, Arnd Dörfler, Jürgen Winkler, Alexander German
pmc-13214570.description: The neuropathological hallmark of Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a progressive degeneration of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra resulting in a reduced striatal dopamine transporter (DaT) concentration. Radioligands can detect degeneration of nigrostriatal projections early in the disease course, but their clinical use is constrained by ionizing radiation exposure and the need for radiotracer production and associated logistics.

pmc-13575970.creator: Linda S. Reitz, Peter C. Müller, Richard Dronskowski
pmc-13575970.description: Classically defined oxidation numbers (in addition to quantum-chemical population analyses) are regularly used to quantify or at least stick to the ionic notion of molecules and solid-state materials. pmc-13662236.title: Outcomes of Revision Modified Broström Procedure with Periosteal Flap Augmentation in Patients with Recurrent Chronic Ankle Instability
pmc-13662236.creator: Jong Jin Moon, Myeong Jun Song, Jun Young Lee
pmc-13662236.description: BackgroundAlthough the modified Broström procedure (MBP) is widely accepted as the standard surgical treatment for chronic ankle instability (CAI), recurrent instability remains a clinical challenge, particularly in patients with poor tissue quality or high functional demands. To overcome these limitations, periosteal flap augmentation has been proposed as a biological alternative for patients with recurrent CAI after failed MBP.
